Subject: Lunaris - vendor setup checklist and security package

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the call earlier. As part of our procurement intake, our team needs the following items to complete the vendor record and issue the PO: 

1) Executed DPA (redlines accepted by both parties)
2) Latest SOC 2 report (PDF or secure link)
3) Current subprocessor list (CSV or spreadsheet)
4) Invoice remit instructions and PO contact

I attached a short vendor intake form your finance team can fill out if easier. If you can send the DPA and SOC 2 link, we can start the legal review and queue the PO. Typical timeline on our side is 5 business days after we have the package.

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (fillable PDF)

Best,

Hi Patricia —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- DPA: Our legal team prefers to send a clean copy for your redline. I attached "Redwood_DPA_v3_for_review.pdf" — please have your counsel mark changes in DocuSign or PDF comments.
- SOC 2: We host an up-to-date SOC 2 report behind a secure link for customers/prospects. I can share a one-time view link once I have a list of recipients. If it helps, I pasted a public summary below.
- Subprocessors: I pulled the live export and attached as CSV. It includes region, service, and subprocessors with contact emails.
- PO & invoicing: Laura (cc'd) manages PO routing — Laura, can you confirm Redwood's vendor code and remit instructions? Also confirm whether Lunaris requires a specific PO header or invoice reference.

Proposed timeline: we will send a DocuSign-enabled DPA by end of day and a SOC 2 one-time link within 24 hours. Please confirm recipient email for the SOC 2 link (Patricia + procurement@lunaris.ai is fine).

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3_for_review.pdf; redwood_subprocessor_export_20280315.csv

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer

Karthik —

Thanks, this looks good. Please send the SOC 2 access link to patricia@lunaris.ai and procurement@lunaris.ai. For the DPA, our legal team will review the PDF redlines; if you can also send a DocuSign packet that would speed things up.

One minor ask on subprocessors: could you highlight any subprocessor that is outside the US or that performs persistent storage of customer data? Our internal team needs that flagged for cross-border assessment. If not possible in the CSV, a one-line note is fine.

Procurement notes: Lunaris requires the PO to include our internal project code (LUN-PRJ-42) in the invoice "Reference" field. We can accept emailed invoices to invoices@lunaris.ai or set up the vendor portal upload — preference is portal if you're already on it.
